title: How tall is each thing?
prompt: Place each one by its height, shortest to tallest.

items.label: An adult human
items.fact: A useful yardstick for judging everything taller.

items.label: A giraffe
items.fact: The tallest land animal — its neck alone can be 2 m.

items.label: A two-story house
items.fact: Roughly the height of two stacked giraffes.

items.label: The Statue of Liberty
items.fact: From base to torch, Lady Liberty stands about 93 m.

items.label: The Eiffel Tower
items.fact: It grows a few centimeters taller in summer as the iron expands.

items.label: The Burj Khalifa
items.fact: The tallest building on Earth — more than twice the Eiffel Tower.
